# Navimower Map Card 0.3.7-beta9

## Cleaner browser console startup logging

- Collapse the accumulated historical startup/version messages into one current-version line:
  `[Navimower Map Card] v0.3.7-beta9 loaded`.
- Keep operational `console.warn`, `console.error` and `console.debug` diagnostics unchanged.
- Make release preparation normalize the startup log automatically so future releases do not reintroduce the historical version list.
- Update cumulative-runtime regression hooks so tests no longer depend on an old console message being present.
